name: our-sacred-place
description: Private WhatsApp-style app for two people. Made with love.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
